Is there any way to split the reservation so that just the outbound flight is upgraded and changed, while the return stays as is? Or maybe rebook only the outbound in business and keep the return in economy, as long as the total extra cost is under $1,000? I’m open to creative solutions, but I need both the date change and the upgrade for the outbound, and I can’t go over my budget.

Let’s try option 1—please check if I can cancel just the outbound segment and get a refund, then book a new one-way business class ticket for May 24. If the total extra cost for this is under $1,000, I’ll go ahead. Can you check and let me know what the numbers look like?

Yes, please go ahead and check the total cost for booking a new one-way business class ticket from Houston to Seattle on May 24 for all three of us. If it’s under $1,000 extra, I’ll confirm. Let me know the price before booking.

That’s still too expensive for me. I really want to make this work, but I can’t go above $1,000 extra. Are there any other creative solutions, like standby upgrades, last-minute deals, or splitting the group if there are fewer business seats available at a lower price? If not, I may have to reconsider, but I’d appreciate any other options you can check.

Thanks for checking, but if there’s no way to get both the date change and business class upgrade for all of us under $1,000 extra, I’ll have to stick with my original reservation for now. I appreciate your help.###STOP###
